title: Aroxybutynin and atomoxetine (AD109) for obstructive sleep apnea: a randomized phase 3 trial (SynAIRgy)
observations_or_assays: AHI under the primary event/desaturation definition
ODI under the reported key-secondary-endpoint definition
time_scope: Baseline to week 26, primary ITT estimand.
excluded: On-treatment estimand, earlier visits, responder/severity categories and subgroups
Hypoxic burden, sleep impairment and safety
population_or_material: The article-defined primary ITT population receiving at least one dose in SynAIRgy.
requested_items: Main ITT Table 2 arithmetic AHI/ODI/PROMIS changes and contrasts; Results AHI geometric-mean percentage reductions/test; directly reported baseline/week-26 observed summaries with endpoint n. Use main-table precision for its estimates. Exclude on-treatment alternatives, categorical AHI responders and superseded qualitative placeholders.
case_specific_rules: Use main ITT Table 2 for requested arithmetic model changes/contrasts and Table E1 for matching observed baseline/week-26 summaries with endpoint-specific n. Keep observed n distinct from randomized/analysis-set totals.

Keep geometric-mean percentage reductions separate from arithmetic changes and observed medians. Retain only numerically reported CI limits; do not estimate geometric-reduction limits from Figure 2 error bars.
